title: 第九章发现骷髅架
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“什么穿着红色衣服的人。”

裴真被吓了一大跳。

顺着黎雾的目光看去，看到的就是空荡荡的土堆。

常年高压学习，她的视力显然没有黎雾好。

见到土堆后轻舒了一口气，轻轻打了黎雾一巴掌：

“你真是吓死我了。”

“只不过是个小土堆而已，这有什么好奇怪的。”

“好了好了，别玩了，下节课是班主任的课，我们先回去上课吧。”

“不是呀，你没有看到吗？”黎雾耐心指点，“就是那堆沙袋旁边，你顺着这个位置看。”

“你看，那个地方，虽然盖上了一层土，但是很明显能够看出来，是昨晚盖上去的，和之前的土颜色不一样。”

“你看这个轮廓，像不像是一个人躺在那里。”

裴真被说得起了一声鸡皮疙瘩，没忍住搓了搓手臂。

再顺着黎雾的视线看去，莫名的，也开始觉得那堆土有点像个人形了。

黎雾开口道：“对吧，我没有说错吧。”

“你说会不会是……”

黎雾话还没有说完，就被裴真毫不犹豫的打断了。

“不可能。”

“黎雾，你就是小说看多了！！！”

“太异想天开了，怎么可能会出现这样的事。”

“你也不想想学校平时里都有学生再，寒暑假有专门的保安和老师值班。”

“谁会傻不愣登的在学校里埋个人。”

“你就是想多了。”

裴真说着脸上浮现出了几抹担忧：

“是不是最近发生的事，让你觉得压力太大了。”

“黎雾，你要是觉得害怕的话，随时可以跟我说。”

“或者我们去看心理医生，你千万不要一个人东想西想。”

裴真把黎雾会变成这样归结于她亲眼目睹了幸福小苑凶杀案现场的后遗症，开始出现了幻想症。

觉得生活里人人都是凶手。

连忙就要带黎雾回教室。

“走走走，我们现在就回教室。”

“马上就要上课了。”

黎雾没办法，被裴真牵着离开天台。

回到教室，班主任已经提前到了。

看了黎雾一眼，显然记得昨天王校长说的事，没有过多为难黎雾，让两人顺利回到位置上坐好。

即使是回到位置上，黎雾的心仍然无法安定下来。

即使裴真已经说了那是她想多了，但是，万一是真的呢？

万一躺在那里的真的是个人怎么办？

她明明都看到了。

Page (1/3)

"Someone in red."

Pei Zhen was shocked.

Following Li Wu's gaze, what he saw was an empty mound of soil.

After studying under high pressure all year round, her eyesight is obviously not as good as Li Wu's.

After seeing the mound, he breathed a sigh of relief and slapped Li Wu gently:

"You really scared me to death."

"It's just a small mound. There's nothing strange about it."

"Okay, okay, stop playing. The next class is the class teacher's class. Let's go back to class first."

"No, didn't you see it?" Li Wu pointed patiently, "It's right next to the pile of sandbags. Look along this position."

"Look, although that place is covered with a layer of soil, it's obvious that it was covered last night, and the color of the soil is different from before."

"Look at this outline, it looks like a person lying there."

Pei Zhen got goosebumps when he was told this, and couldn't help but rub his arms.

Looking along Li Wu's line of sight again, inexplicably, he began to feel that the pile of soil looked a bit like a human figure.

Li Wu said: "Yes, I am not wrong."

"Do you think it could be..."

Before Li Wu finished speaking, he was interrupted by Pei Zhen without hesitation.

"No way."

"Li Wu, you just read too many novels!!!"

"It's too whimsical. How could such a thing happen?"

"You don't want to think about the fact that there are students in the school during the week, and there are dedicated security guards and teachers on duty during the winter and summer vacations."

"Who would be so stupid as to bury someone in school?"

"You just think too much."

Pei Zhen said with some worry on his face:

"Is it because what happened recently made you feel too stressed?"

"Li Wu, if you feel scared, you can tell me at any time."

"Or we can see a psychiatrist. You must not think about it alone."

Pei Zhen attributed Li Wuhui's situation to the sequelae of witnessing the murder scene in Xingfu Xiaoyuan, and began to suffer from hallucinations.

I feel like everyone in life is a murderer.

He quickly took Li Wu back to the classroom.

"Let's go back to the classroom now."

"Class will start soon."

Li Wu had no choice but to be led away from the rooftop by Pei Zhen.

Back in the classroom, the head teacher has arrived early.

After taking a look at Li Wu, he obviously remembered what Principal Wang said yesterday. He didn't embarrass Li Wu too much and allowed the two of them to return to their seats and sit down smoothly.

Even after returning to his position, Li Wu's heart still couldn't settle down.

Even if Pei Zhen has said that she is overthinking, what if it is true?

What if that person lying there really was a human being?

She obviously saw it all.
